posts.text: If you're buying a used Tesla, HW4 isn't obsolete yet. Tesla said on its Q1 2026 earnings call that "AI4 is sufficient for unsupervised Full Self-Driving." HW5 slipped to ~mid-2027, and even the Cybercab launches on HW4. FSD v15 runs on it too. Three-year hold: you're current, not stranded.
